_comment: Evaluation external-listener pool: Claude Sonnet 5 at medium effort. This is the pool configs/eval_suite.json points at, and the guesser evaluation uses -- every other pool in this directory is for training or diagnostics (see docs/iteration-architecture.md's 'two roles for guessers'). Chosen over Opus 5 on cost: 25 paired positions showed no detectable difference (-0.04 own/turn, 95% CI [-0.22, +0.14]) at roughly a fifth of the price -- see docs/log.md 'Sonnet vs. Opus as the evaluation guesser'. Opus (configs/guesser_pool_llm_opus.json) is reserved for the final headline numbers only. Caveat worth stating in a defense: this is also the listener expected_words' sigma=2.5 was chosen against (scripts/tools/sweep_sigma.py --model claude-sonnet-5:medium, see docs/versions/expected_words.md), so that baseline is evaluated on the guesser it was tuned for. 'effort' is part of the response-cache key (codenames/guessers/llm.py::cache_model_id), so changing it here will not silently reuse rankings produced at a different effort -- but it WILL change EvalSuite.suite_id. Shares cache/llm_store.db with the Opus and Haiku entries; keyed by model+effort, so no collision.
